Name: Sexy Alex Muscular Sprite
Author: CommanderWaddles
Description:
This mod replaces Alex's vanilla sprites with a bigger, muscled bodybuilder version.

So you did you ever want an muscular Alex... but sexy? He becomes huge and muscular. The pixelated muscles are all natural, like seriously, no steroids involved! Haha. I apologize for creating this bulging monstrosity...
His general workout consists of tossing a gridball up and down and then lifting weights... up and down! Giving him a Complete Breakfast gives him protein, endless stamina (jk) and affection points! Muscles galore!

This mod also contains a folder with a .png file to replace with [DCBurger's Portraits (Hi-Res Version)] version of Alex. This file is optional, but if you want to include it, I recommend following a guide and installing [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999/?]Platonymous's Portraiture mod.[/url] It makes Sexy Alex muscular & shirtless in his dialogue too! 

Muscles!

[font=Consolas][color=#f1f1f1][size=5]How to Install[/size][/color][/font][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
How to Include Portrait (Optional):
1. Install [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]1.9 or later version SAMPI[/url]
2. Download and unzip [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999/?]Platonymous's Portraiture mod[/url]
3. Put Portraiture folder into C:\Program Files\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods
4. Download and unzip DCBurger's Portrait mod(Hi-Res).zip file.
5. Create a "new folder" in "Mods\Portraiture\Portraits"
6. Put the .Png file of Alex from DCBurger's Portrait mod(Hi-Res) into the "new folder" (It should look like: "Stardew_Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits\new folder\Alex.png")
7. COPY the Alex.png file from our Alex but Hunkier mod --> "Stardew_Valley\Mods\[CP]_Alex_but_Hunkier\assets\portraits\Alex.png"
8. PASTE into "Stardew_Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits\new folder" and REPLACE the file.
9. Run the game with StardewModdingAPI.exe and talk to Alex in the game. To change the portrait, press P at the dialog box.

Downloads.Description:
Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods. Make sure to have Content Patcher!

*Includes an optional "Alex.png" file. It is a portrait of Alex shirtless. It was edited from DCBurger's Portraits and has to be installed manually with Portraiture.
